title: Bring the desktop DBC read-model client validation to domain parity
objective: The desktop DBC read-model client refuses a malformed Runtime read model at the client boundary instead of admitting it into renderer state: duplicate asset ids, duplicate frame ids inside one database, and a frame whose is_extended disagrees with its frame_id range are rejected with a typed client error. This closes the recorded limitation that client-side validation is contract-shape only (docs/PROJECT_STATE.md §9).
scope: The DBC read-model client validator and its vitest suite.
non_goals: Re-implementing the Runtime domain validator - the Runtime stays authoritative
Changing the Runtime HTTP contract or any module under runtime/
Adding UI, a new panel, or any new user-visible behaviour
acceptance_criteria: A read model carrying two assets with the same asset id is refused with a typed client error, and no renderer state is produced from it
A read model carrying two frames with the same frame id, or a frame whose is_extended disagrees with its frame_id, is refused the same way
A well-formed read model is still accepted unchanged - the change adds no false rejection
handoff_requirements: Report the exact command and result for pnpm test, pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint at the repository root
Name the new test cases and confirm the pre-existing dbc-client tests still pass
State explicitly that no Runtime file and no Rust file was touched
